summary_1line: Narada reflects on fate, impermanence, birth, illness, and rebirth, urging self-discipline and detachment as life’s events unfold beyond human control.

image_candidates.scene_text: Days and nights flow like an endless river carrying away the lives of human beings who stand helpless on its banks.
An embryo lies in the dark womb surrounded by fluids while unseen forces sustain its fragile life.
Death seizes a desire-filled man like a tiger snatching prey and vanishing into the forest.
